svg.title: Reasoning across school subjects
svg.desc: Observe the parts: A food network includes farms, trade and local demand.. Study their interaction: A change in one part can affect supplies elsewhere.. Watch thresholds: Pressure can build before behaviour changes abruptly.

g.text: A food network includes farms, trade and local demand.
A change in one part can affect supplies elsewhere.
Pressure can build before behaviour changes abruptly.
